capabilities.rationale: Static workflow and dispatch validators are CI guardrails, not human-facing analytical workflows.
Health probing supports launch and CI readiness rather than a separate user workflow.
Batch ETL/materialization jobs that build the campaign-finance dataset served by campaign-finance-tracker; run offline outside the GUI, not a separate user workflow.
Batch ingestion/materialization for OM contract-universe, PRASA transition contracts, PPP coverage, and the federal financial-program registry; run offline, not surfaced in the dashboard.
CI/release validation and the offline-baseline build orchestrator; run in automation ahead of a release, not a user-facing workflow.
Case-manager schema, repository and service layer; the package's own docstring states it is "deliberately UI-agnostic" and it has no dashboard integration.
Contract Forensics V3 persistent-memory engine; a backend evidence-correlation library with no dashboard integration.

Batch ingestion for the rdc_demandas_civiles source (Registro de Demandas Civiles, Ley 1-2003): a paginated list sweep plus a resumable per-case detail pass. Both run offline and render nothing — zero references in dashboard/src. Their outputs (data/staging/processed/pr_rdc_demandas_civiles.csv and pr_rdc_demandas_parties.csv) reach the operator through the existing public-money-intelligence-dashboard capability, like every other ingested source. The detail pass is additionally operator-paced by design (~44,700 requests against a small government host, bounded per run via --limit / --max-runtime), so it is an operator-run batch job rather than an interactive workflow; it is deliberately not wired into a blocking pipeline stage.

Canonical investor identity, source provenance, strict ingestion, supersession, temporal analytics, and authoritative SEC acquisition/materialization are backend/operator infrastructure. They remain intentionally non-user-facing until a separately certified API and GUI vector is implemented.
Batch acquisition and shard recovery for the Puerto Rico assistance denominator; operator-run CLIs executed offline against USAspending bulk jobs, not surfaced in the dashboard.

exceptions.reason: Case Manager Phase 1 exposes a service boundary but its claim and evidence-relation workflows are not yet available through the shipped dashboard. Keep the ratchet explicit until the complete GUI path is delivered.
The bounded forensics engine remains an analyst CLI and library pending a discoverable dashboard workflow with evidence, provenance, and safe acquisition controls.

scripts/compare_entity_products.py landed on main (entity-product comparison audit tool) after this PR's baseline was built; it is a terminal-only analysis/diagnostic script with no user-facing GUI surface. Excepted pending either a GUI rendering of its comparison report or its classification as pipeline tooling.
